description: Proof of delivery check. Verifies a delivery receipt: the seller's signature over the deliverable hash (SHA-256) and, if present, the buyer's countersignature. Returns countersigned, seller-only or invalid, with reasons. Optionally compares a file's SHA-256 with the deliverable hash. Relevant to a delivery dispute or to checking a seller before payment. Free, no sign-up, no API key.

file_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 (hex) of a local file to compare with the receipt.

receipt.description: A Wayreceipt delivery receipt (W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0 with eddsa-jcs-2022 proofs).

name: verify_delivery_receipt
title: Verify a delivery receipt
